. Like other event maps, this map had a specialized wave structure with special enemies. Players started with a varying amount of cash, based on how many players there were in the match. The rewards received were based on how many waves were survived and if the match was won. This map had two difficulties, Easy and Hard.

Cash is only gained if an enemy was killed, or in some cases, damaged by a specific amount of health. Additionally, the amount gained was a set amount of cash, which was not always equal to the enemy's health. Enemies split their cash between players, regardless of how much damage the player dealt to it. If, in a duo, one player did all the damage to an enemy, both players would receive 50% of the cash the enemy would normally give in solo. This means that in solo, you received 100% of the cash when an enemy is killed, or it was damaged enough. With each additional player, this is reduced to 50% in duo, 33% in trio and 25% in quad. If it was a decimal, it gets rounded up or down depending on the decimal value. If it is at least 0.5, it gets rounded up. If it is less than 0.5, it gets rounded down.
Health of enemies in this mode scaled with player count and difficulty.
In Easy, the increase was 20% in duo, 40% in trio and 60% in quad.
In Hard, the increase was 15% in duo, 30% in trio and 40% in quad.

Each player was allowed to pick from one of three preset loadouts in each difficulty. Alongside these preset options, players could opt to use their current loadout as the first choice. However, if one's loadout contained no towers, this option would be unavailable.

Welcome one, welcome all! Join me for a story that's older than the realms themselves. *Cough* - I'm sure my honored guest will arrive soon, probably just uh...hah...running late.
Say anything and I'll make you regret being given a voice actor.
Long ago, two brothers ruled over all creation. Each saw the Old World as a blank canvas, but like any artist, each viewed the world much differently.

One wanted those who lived in the Old World to create a place of their own, while the other thought the only interesting world is one created from chaos. And I HATE to agree, but peace is such a DRAG.
I don't understand, what do you mean by a world 'created from chaos?'
Imagine creatures beyond anything you've ever seen! The war-torn landscape, the endless carnage, the ruthless battles! A universe where the strong crushes the weak.
Watch out! Those Builders are stunning us!

You see, Two X believed everyone had a place in the world, so he helped nurture them. Meanwhile, Lord Exo created creatures as tall as buildings while wiping out thousands that didn't suit his vision. Oh, how I can hear them begging for mercy.
Whoops! Sorry. that was supposed to be *millions*.

Eventually, the two sides clashed and tensions rose Two X approached Lord Exo, offering to work together to create something immaculate. Lord Exo sat In silence for a long moment, and without warning a sword materialized in his hand, striking Two X to his knees.
Two X looked up at him in shock as he said 'You should have known that I would never work with someone who's beneath me.' You should have seen the look on his face!

Oh Commander. You know. In that moment watched something die inside Two X, and I think it Was the realization that Lord Exo was right about one thing. There wasn't a world where they could ever be equals.
It's tragic really. One second you're a character without any lore and the next you're being stabbed by your brother. Too bad he couldn't black out his profile.

Yeah it does that - ANYWAYS! After Two X escaped, both sides began attacking the other. What Lord Exo lacked in numbers he had in strength, and at one point it was clear this would be the bloodiest of wars.
The Old World was torn apart piece by piece and countless victims met their end. Just like how you'll meet yours if you don't place some hidden detection!

Spears that were faster than light shot warriors from the sky as explosions littered the battlefield. Bodies were scattered about, Lord Exo's beasts crunching into flesh and bone like eating a celery stick, it was AWESOME!
This freak isn't telling a story anymore, he's just reminiscing.

As the battlefield spread across the entirety of the Old World. Lord Exo and Two X met face to face, surrounded by the bodies of their followers. Their weapons were drawn-one siphoning the sous of the corrupted and the other was fueled by sacrifice. One takes, the other receives.

Each sword swing cut down mountains and each strike sent shockwaves that knocked the wind out of your chest! I could barely breathe as I watched from a distance, staining every dramatic moment into memory!
You worship a psychopath! All of those people and everything he's done! Its-!

Their battle went on for days, then weeks. Pockets of unstable energy were scattered across the landscape because of their abilities. Two X watched as everything he fought to protect crumbled while Lord Exo thrived in the chaos. It was then that Two X had to make a choice.

Where Two X's army fought exhaustion, Lord Exo's never tired. If he didn't end the battle soon, all he wanted to protect would be lost. Looking to his strongest fighters, they willingly sacrificed themselves to create a prison.
In only a few seconds, he turned thousands of his followers into an energy source; and then-
That's when the God Cube was created.
Enough of the stories! Tell me where Dispatcher is!

Man, you're such a buzz-kill! All I did was help murder one of the two people keeping your realm from collapsing and maybe causing you to lose your friend. WHO CARES! You think you have it bad? I lost my FAVORITE frog in that battle. Man, Frank threw the best parties...

Once the prison was created, Two X caught Lord Exo off-guard. When their swords connected, he grabbed the hilt and held Lord Exo in place. The corruption from the sword burned his hands, but Two X used his followers to drag Lord Exo into the Cube.
Then where was Two X when Lord Exo came back?
HOW SHOULD I KNOW?! Maybe he was standing on a cliff with a galaxy in his hand aura farming or something.
Careful! Whatever that enemy is, they're hurting us with those shockwaves!
Just like how the Old World was hurting everyone who survived the war! Now that Lord Exo was defeated, Two X was left with an uninhabitable wasteland that became the Nil Zone!
Wait, we were in the Old World?!

The chaotic energy in the Nil Zone was beginning to corrupt the few that remained, including myself, so that was when Two X used the rest of his power to create Paradise, the seed of a growing tree that all realms are created from.
Leaving the Old World behind, everyone started making a new home that Two x had always envisioned. Cities were created, landscapes were terraformed, alliances were made! It was all so-beautiful!
BEAUTIFULLY BORING! HOW POINTLESS! Why would you create the most impressive realm in the universe with smiling families and overwhelming prosperity if there isn't any DRAMA?!
It wasn't all bad, though. When I was in Paradise, I found the most gorgeous woman of all.
Hard to imagine anyone would fall in love with you.
If you say one more thing, they'll be forced to change the game's age rating.
Ah! There's the love of my life! She uplifted me and gave me hope! Now all I can do is recollect on our memories through this indistinguishable version of her.
Oh, if only I could be happy with her once again. She's standing there like the day we first met. My dearest Producer. Lefty and Righty have recreated you as perfectly as I can remember...
No, no. Don't make me feel better...

Now that you SHATTERED my heart to pieces just like THEY DID, I can tell you how Two X began creating a branching web of realms. This and many others are all connected and held together by a single string. Including yours.

Calling it 'The Meta', he and the Rift Walker carefully protect it by dumping any waste into the Nil Zone. What used to be our home is now a dumping ground for trash and tetanus. But hey, at least it doesn't have a zombie problem THAT YOU KEEP FORGETTING TO FIX.
Like seriously! You went from fighting zombies to people who can destroy a realm if they sneeze. What's WRONG with you guys?!

Now after a certain amount of time that the writer doesn't want to explain, Paradise became a distant memory, and that's probably where Two X is trying to stop all realms from collapsing. Though, it's only a matter of time at this rate.
Soon we'll all be thrown into the Nil Zone and either die horribly or become ugly and mutated.
Well, maybe just MUTATED for you.
Trust me, it won't be the Nil Zone that'll kill you...
Now my INSUFFERABLE guests, it's time for our grand finale!
I sure hope you don't fix those CONVENIENTLY placed spotlights as I close the curtain on your AMATEUR act! Like, you can't be serious. We're doing a callback now?
Already did when you weren't looking.
OH OF COURSE YOU DID! Man I hate those devs!
One icon and dialogue is randomly chosen upon defeat:
•Mission Failed, we'll get em' next time.
•Mistakes are just part of the journey..
